The '''House of Demesne''' was a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] house active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They ruled over a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with wisdom and benevolence, and were loved by the people. The head of the House carried the title "[[Lord/Legends|Lord]]."<ref name="RPG1" />
